statement: A tenant configured to fail closed on lag (`cosec.authorization.snapshot.fail-closed.tenants`, where `*` names every tenant) is not decided on when the oldest document its evaluation reads was last confirmed by the store longer ago than `fail-closed.max-lag`: the request is indeterminate (503) unless a DENY matches. Other tenants, and views within the bound, are decided as usual.
guards: runtime:DocumentSnapshotViewsTest#a fail-closed tenant past its lag bound is unresolved, others decide
runtime:DocumentSnapshotViewsTest#with a star every tenant past its lag bound is unresolved
